title: Sadie’s Clubhouse, an activity center assembled from my terrible memory of 90s games
author: yaosio
selftext:
Do you remember playing games as a kid, how big they were, and all the things you could do in them, then you stumble upon one again and discover there's about 5 minutes of gameplay and looks nothing how you remember it? That's what inspired Sadie's Clubhouse.

Sadie's Clubhouse is a lost shareware 90's activity center staring my late cat Sadie, built to be how I remember games from the 90's rather than how they really were. It has some weirdness, it has activities, it has a cute mascot begging to be turned into licensed merchandise. Just like so many lost shareware games of the 90's this will never be finished. I will keep adding as more ideas come to me.

You can check out an early version here. There's just a few things to do right now, but over time I'll keep adding. [https://claude.ai/artifact/3vqbn276s3a4hCN462QjsB](https://claude.ai/artifact/3vqbn276s3a4hCN462QjsB) The artifact is the live version, so if it updates while you're in it, it will restart.

This has taken numerous prompts to get to where it is now, no one shotting. Everything is made programmatically by Claude; art, sounds, and music, all in Javascript.

Enjoy!

comments.author: HornyNarwahl
comments.body: Love the idea/vibe. You said all the art is made by Claude, how is it generating textures and 3d models? It's getting a pretty consistent result.

replies.author: yaosio
replies.body:
Thanks!

It is creating all of it progranatically. It created a style guide for itself and also shares assets where appropriate. Sometimes I have it create mockups. It doesn't always keep the correct style though. While Sadie the cat is small, when I have it make other characters they are much bigger than her. Although this does help treat her as special as she's the only small character.
